seo.title: Wireless Temperature Sensor for Remote Monitoring | Hitelecom
seo.description: Customizable H Series wireless temperature sensors for industrial sites, pharmaceutical storage and laboratories. Sensing design, range, 4G, NB-IoT or LoRa.

hero.value_heading:
The right reading.
From the right point.
hero.description: The Hitelecom H Series wireless temperature sensor brings readings from selected measurement points to remote monitoring and configured alerts. Product form, enclosure, sensing arrangement and range can be customized for industrial sites, pharmaceutical storage and laboratories. Select the wireless configuration and reporting profile for your installation, with data delivered to Hitelecom Cloud or a compatible customer platform. The external-probe design shown is one available configuration.
quick_points: Product form, sensing arrangement and range matched to your project
Hitelecom Cloud or compatible customer platforms

features.title: Remote temperature monitoring
features.text: Bring readings from distributed measurement points into the selected monitoring platform.

features.title: Configurable threshold alerts
features.text: Set temperature limits for the application and agree the notification workflow with your platform.

features.title: Customizable product design
features.text: Match the product form, enclosure and sensing arrangement to your installation. Published family ranges span −200°C to +800°C through selected probe and input configurations.

features.title: Accuracy options
features.text: ±0.5°C is listed, with ±0.1°C customization available. Agree the accuracy for your working range and complete measurement configuration.

features.title: IP68-rated enclosure
features.text: IP68-rated enclosure options support demanding installations. Match the supplied device, sensing assembly and enclosure protection to the site.

features.title: NFC configuration
features.text: NFC activation and local setup are listed for the family. Match the configuration method to the supplied model.

features.title: Wireless connection options
features.text: Choose a 4G, NB-IoT or LoRa variant for the available network, regional requirements and integration path.

features.title: Low-power operation
features.text: A design reference of over 10 years at hourly reporting under specified test conditions. Match the battery and operating profile to your project.

measurement.heading: Start with the measurement point.
measurement.description: Room air, a pipe wall and the liquid inside that pipe represent different temperatures. Define what you need to measure, then select the product design, sensing arrangement and installation position.

cards.title: Air temperature
cards.text: For rooms, cold stores and equipment air inlets. Position the sensing point where the air represents your monitoring objective, with suitable exposure and separation from local heat sources.
cards.project_brief: Room or cabinet layout · Representative positions · Airflow · Required response

cards.title: Surface temperature
cards.text: For accessible equipment housings, pipe walls and selected surfaces. Specify the contact method, surface material and insulation so the probe measures the intended surface consistently.
cards.project_brief: Surface material · Contact method · Working temperature · Access for installation

cards.title: Immersion temperature
cards.text: For liquids, tanks and process media. Specify the medium, pressure, insertion depth and connection so the sensing element reaches the intended measurement zone.
cards.project_brief: Medium · Pressure · Insertion depth · Wetted materials · Process connection

measurement.installation_heading:
Plan the sensing point.
Match the device to the site.
measurement.installation_text: Select the sensing arrangement for the measured temperature and the device for its operating environment. For external-probe configurations, position the transmitter within its specified electronics and battery conditions. Mounting, exposure, cable routing where applicable, and wireless coverage belong in the same installation plan.

workflow.heading:
Know the temperature.
Give your team a clear next step.

steps.title: Measure
steps.text: The selected sensing configuration measures temperature at the defined point. Choose sampling requirements according to how quickly the monitored conditions can change.

steps.title: Transmit
steps.text: Readings travel through the selected cellular or LoRa configuration. Agree the reporting interval and connection path before deployment.

steps.title: Review
steps.text: Use the connected platform to review readings, trends and configured alerts. Define who receives a notification and what action follows.

workflow.platform_text: Connect to Hitelecom Cloud or a compatible customer platform. MQTT is listed in the published specification; confirm message format, authentication and the gateway or server path for the selected wireless variant.
workflow.profile_heading:
Match the reporting profile
to the operation.
workflow.profile_text: Sampling is when the device measures temperature. Reporting is when data is sent. Define both alongside the alert response your team needs, rather than selecting an interval from battery life alone.
workflow.battery_text: The published family is designed for over 10 years of battery life at one-hour reporting under specified test conditions. Actual service life depends on the selected model, battery and sensing configuration, network coverage, retransmissions, temperature, sampling rate and reporting interval.

faqHeading.title: Frequently asked questions.
faqHeading.intro: Practical answers for choosing the product design and sensing configuration, planning the installation and connecting your temperature data.

faqs.question: Can the product form and sensing arrangement be customized?
paragraphs: Yes. The product form, enclosure, mounting and sensing arrangement can be customized for the application. The external-probe design shown is one available configuration. Share what you need to measure, the available space, mounting, environmental conditions and required performance so Hitelecom can review the appropriate design and configuration.

faqs.question: How do I choose the sensing arrangement for air, surface or liquid temperature?
paragraphs: Start with what you need to measure. Air monitoring needs representative placement and exposure; surface monitoring needs reliable thermal contact; immersion monitoring needs suitable insertion depth, materials and a process connection. Share the normal and peak temperatures, required response time, preferred product form and installation conditions so the sensing arrangement can be selected for the task.

faqs.question: What temperature range can the H Series monitor?
paragraphs: The published H Series family range is −200°C to +800°C through selected probe and input configurations. The selected sensing arrangement and input determine the range for a particular installation. For external-probe designs, the probe, cable and transmitter each need to suit their operating conditions. Specify both the measured temperature and the device’s surrounding temperature for your project.

faqs.question: How should I specify accuracy and calibration for my project?
paragraphs: The published accuracy is ±0.5°C, with ±0.1°C customization available. Specify the accuracy you need over your actual working range, together with the complete measurement configuration. If your procedure requires calibration, include the test temperatures, allowable tolerance, certificate and measurement-uncertainty requirements in the quotation brief.

faqs.question: How should I plan temperature monitoring for pharmaceutical storage and laboratories?
paragraphs: Start with the material’s storage instructions and the laboratory’s operating procedure. Select representative positions for medicine storage, temperature-sensitive medical supplies, samples, reagents and laboratory environments, using temperature mapping where appropriate. Specify the working range, accuracy, response, calibration documents and recording, reporting or alert requirements so the complete configuration can be reviewed.

faqs.question: How do sampling and reporting intervals affect battery life?
paragraphs: Sampling determines when temperature is measured; reporting determines when readings are transmitted. Select both around the speed of temperature change and the response you need. The published battery-life design exceeds 10 years at one-hour reporting under specified test conditions. Service life also depends on the selected configuration, temperature, network coverage and retransmissions.

faqs.question: Can temperature readings connect to our own platform?
paragraphs: The published H Series supports Hitelecom Cloud and compatible customer platforms, with MQTT listed for data integration. Specify the wireless variant, regional network and platform requirements. For a LoRa installation, confirm the radio protocol and gateway or server path for the supplied model; the device and backend integration need to be matched as one system.

faqs.question: What should I send for a configuration proposal and quotation?
paragraphs: Send the application, country, quantity, measurement point, normal and peak temperatures, required accuracy and response. Add the preferred product form, dimensions, mounting and environmental conditions, plus any probe, cable, medium, pressure or cleaning requirements. Include the wireless connection, sampling and reporting needs, platform requirements and calibration documents so Hitelecom can review a suitable configuration and quotation.
